$comment: Which source documents become portal documents, and where each one lands.
Metadata only — no policy text lives here, so this file is safe in a public
repo. The .docx sources are NOT in the repo and must not be: put them in a
local folder and point PORTAL_SOURCE_DIR at it.
section    — instructor hub (/portal) section. Omit to keep a document out of it.
hqSection  — Peak HQ (/hq) section. Omit to keep a document out of HQ.
tier 1     — versioned, referenced by the instructor contract
tier 2     — shared standard, instructors and staff
tier 3     — staff only; must NOT have a `section` (the importer refuses)
replace    — literal [find, replace] pairs applied to the converted text, for
stale references (HubSpot merge tags, Rezdy, Pipedrive) now that
SkiOperator is the only system. Visible here so they get reviewed.
Deliberately absent: third-party copyright, board material (cash flow,
dividend), Customer payments (documents Rezdy end to end; needs rewriting for
SkiOperator), the HubSpot guides (retired), and the Sales & Marketing JD
